dishes.name: Safranbolu saffron lokum
dishes.desc: Turkish delight made with cornstarch and sugar, coloured gold and lightly scented with saffron. Made here since the Ottoman period and sold in boxes in the old town.

dishes.name: Zerde
dishes.desc: Sweet rice dessert with saffron, sugar and rice, served cold, often topped with walnuts. Descended from palace cooking and tied to the saffron that gave the town its name.

dishes.name: Peruhi
dishes.desc: Hand-rolled dough squares filled with strained yogurt or keş and mint, folded into triangles, boiled and finished with butter. Sometimes called yoğurtlu mantı.

dishes.name: Safranbolu bükme
dishes.desc: Savoury pastry of rolled dough with minced meat, spinach, onion and pepper, finished with butter and often served with sour cherry syrup.

dishes.name: Çullu börek
dishes.desc: Layered pastry of yufka sheets baked on a griddle, with some cut into strips between whole sheets in a copper tray and finished with butter.
